title: Sharp dimension-three finite bound and compact six-variable Ramsey refutation

claims: For every n, any full-B2 circuit computing a Boolean function nonconstant on every dimension-three affine subspace has at least 4n-16 gates, and the additive constant8 in 4n-8*3+8 is sharp: h(x,y,u,v,z)=xy XOR uv XOR z has circuit size exactly four and no monochromatic affine three-flat. The complete proof includes a regenerated 83-case reverse-unit-propagation certificate proving that every six-variable Boolean function has a monochromatic affine three-flat; no cited classification is a premise. This fixed-dimension refinement is supplied in elimination.md Section7 and the declared audit. It changes neither the main family nor its leading (4,1) guarantee.

experiments.purpose: Exact standard-library verification of5945 reverse-unit-propagation lemmas refuting all84-state bad-forcing colorings after complete domain/core/group/CNF regeneration, and4082400 normalized read-once assignments across350 tree orbits; also scoped affine-role-exchange, potential, terminal-ledger, algebraic and family predicates. Universal4m-8d+7 for d>=3, all normalization coverage, eligibility and asymptotics are proved in the supplied Markdown. Also exactly regenerate and refute83 complete six-variable Ramsey cases using5185 checked reverse-unit-propagation clauses. Section7 supplies the reduction, fixed-dimension circuit consequence and sharpness proof.
